Nora K: Drafting a short customer runbook: 'Onboard Pulse + Prefill/Batch/Stream playbook' \u2014 quick review?
Ethan B: Love the compact format. Can we add a tiny triage matrix for renewal risk vs telemetry?
Ravi S: Yes. Propose three signals: failed_streams_48h, prefetch_miss_rate, customer_feedback_score. Map to actions.
Lina M: Add AE steps: 1) reproduce with curl, 2) validate headers, 3) test lower-model fallback, 4) log a support ticket if persists.
Nora K: Good. Short header samples I put in doc:
```
X-Prefill: mode=on;ttl=600
X-Batch: mode=adaptive;max_wait_ms=40
X-Stream: prefill=2;keepalive=1
```
Ethan B: For telemetry event payload suggestion:
```
event: cs.onboard_pulse
props: {onboard_pct:0.6, failed_streams:1, prefetch_hits_24h:14, avg_latency_ms:140, feedback:4}
```
Ravi S: Escalation rule: if failed_streams >=2 AND feedback <=2 within 72h -> mark `renewal_risk` and notify AE + CS lead. Include canned outreach script.
Lina M: Add reproducible curl example for customers/AEs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'X-Prefill: mode=on;ttl=600'
  -d '{"prompt":"stream test","stream":true}'
```
Nora K: Also included a fallback play: switch to non-stream + smaller model + enable aggressive batching, add `reduced_streaming` tag on account.
Ethan B: I'm ok with TTL defaults: 600 for small-chatty, 300 for heavy-token. Document tradeoffs.
Ravi S: I'll wire the telemetry fields into weekly rollups. Lina, can you draft the AE email template?
Lina M: On it, will share by EOD.
CS Bot: runbook-draft-created by Nora K (link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/onboard-pulse-187654)
Nora K: Thanks team \u2014 will merge after Lina's email template. :thumbsup:
